result.title: Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression
result.summary: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks explicit equations that explain observed data, and recent methods increasingly employ large language models (LLMs) and agents for equation discovery. However, these systems typically rely on manually designed workflows and prompts. We argue that the SR agent harness should itself be an optimization target: its design shapes search priors and how numerical feedback guides subsequent equation refinement. We therefore propose HarnessSR, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts and workflows to construct reusable SR agents. During both harness optimization and agent execution, HarnessSR supports either PySR or an LLM-based equation generator through tool-specific interfaces, allowing the framework to optimize search guidance for different equation-discovery mechanisms. HarnessSR first optimizes role prompts through equation-discovery feedback in basic workflows, then jointly searches prompt assignments and workflows with brief adaptation to align the two. Finally, it refines role instructions through reflection on residual patterns, candidate equation structures, and search outcomes, improving how these signals guide subsequent equation search. On LSR-Synth in LLM-SRBench, HarnessSR achieves a mean ID $\mathrm{Acc}_{0.01}$ of 61.33% across three backbones, a 45.0% relative improvement over the next-best baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HarnessSR：把符号回归（SR）agent 的提示与工作流本身当作优化对象，先用方程发现反馈优化角色提示，再联合搜索提示分配与工作流，并依据残差模式、候选方程结构与搜索结果反思精炼角色指令，在 LLM-SRBench 上取得明显提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态主线无直接关系，但「把 agent 脚手架（提示与工作流）作为优化目标、用搜索过程中的数值反馈迭代精炼」这一方法线索，可能可供核查——用于 LVR 中推理 scaffold 的设计与监督信号/贡献分配，属推测性借鉴。
